item.title: Correction · Mission Bay School: The record now gives the construction contract as about $95.4 million (SF Standard, Aug 2026) instead of $95,390,000, and says SFUSD scheduled construction to finish by January 2026 rather than stating that it was completed. The first day of school is shown as August 2026, since the readable sources give only the month. The 2022 UCSF site transfer and 1988 set-aside, the Multistudio architect credit, the Architecture 2030 claim, the attendee list at the 2022 groundbreaking and the 'first new school in 20 years' wording were removed or corrected because no cited source supports them. Sources were added for the design-build team, the Proposition A bond and the fourth-floor program.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay School: A check for the same timeline bug found on 'Prequel Park (Power Station sub-area)' found that this record's August 2032 milestone ('School is planned to grow one grade per year into a full TK-5 (with Preschool) campus') was tagged 'planned', even though the school is already built and open. Scrubbing the timeline past August 2032 would have shown the open school reverting to 'planned'. The milestone describes enrollment growth, not a change in construction status, so the tag was removed; its date, text and sources are unchanged.
item.description: A check for the same timeline bug found on 'Prequel Park (Power Station sub-area)' found that this record's August 2032 milestone ('School is planned to grow one grade per year into a full TK-5 (with Preschool) campus') was tagged 'planned', even though the school is already built and open. Scrubbing the timeline past August 2032 would have shown the open school reverting to 'planned'. The milestone describes enrollment growth, not a change in construction status, so the tag was removed; its date, text and sources are unchanged. Source: SFUSD, Mission Bay School (https://www.sfusd.edu/school/mission-bay-school); SFUSD, Mission Bay School opens August 2026, 2025-10-10 (https://www.sfusd.edu/announcements/2025-10-10-mission-bay-school-opens-august-2026); The San Francisco Standard, 2026-08-06 (https://sfstandard.com/2026/08/06/mission-bay-school-opens/).
